description: This Java source file defines an Android AccessibilityService named SampleInputMethodAccessibilityService. It demonstrates how to implement input method APIs, interact with accessibility events, and provide a custom UI overlay with controls for input and accessibility functions.

classes.name: SampleInputMethodAccessibilityService
classes.description: Main class extending AccessibilityService, implementing an example input method with accessibility features and UI overlay.

classes.name: InputMethodImpl
classes.description: Inner class extending InputMethod, providing implementations for input-related actions like start/end input, update selection, etc.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes overlays and UI, sets up EventMonitor, and creates the custom control window when the service is connected.

methods.name: onCreateInputMethod
methods.description: Creates and returns a new InputMethod instance for handling input.

methods.name: addButtons
methods.description: Utility method to programmatically add button groups to the layout, each performing specific input or accessibility actions.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Empty implementation—would handle accessibility events if needed.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Empty implementation—would handle interruption of the service if needed.
